name: Kalyani Steels Limited
summary: Kalyani Steels Limited manufactures and sells iron and steel products in India and internationally. The company provides rolled bars for various automotive applications, including crankshaft, camshaft, connecting rods, gears, transmission shafts, axle beams, steering knuckles, and others. It also offers rolled bars for engineering applications comprising alloyed steels for use in energy, railways, defense, fasteners, and material handling. In addition, the company provides round cast for seamless tube sector.
